jobs.program: Summer Clerkship 2027 Recruitment Program (scheme-wide dates for participating NSW employers)
jobs.notes: Scheme opens 9:00am AEST Wed 9 June 2027 with offers from 9:00am Wed 8 September 2027; the Law Society lists two alternative closing dates (Sun 4 July and Sun 11 July 2027) depending on the employer, so a single scheme-wide close date cannot be stated — eligibility is penultimate-year students.

jobs.employer: The Law Society of New South Wales
jobs.program: Graduate Recruitment Program 2027 (scheme-wide dates for participating NSW employers)
jobs.notes: The Law Society has published 2027 Graduate Recruitment Program key dates and 2027 guidelines, with the market-offer timetable beginning Monday 22 February 2027, but I could not read the full key-dates table to confirm which date is the open and which is the close, so both are left null rather than guessed.

The firm's own early-careers page states applications are currently closed and will open in June for the 2027/28 seasonal clerkship program, but gives no exact day, and state-by-state dates will follow each law society's 2027 guidelines.

The firm's own careers page states applications for the 2027 Sydney law graduate program are open to final-year students commencing in February, but publishes no open or close date, so both fields are null.
